sources.title: Piracy monthly report April 2025
sources.text: While underway, four armed perpetrators on a small vessel approached the ship. In response, the ship shone its lights at the perpetrators’ vessel and sounded its whistle. The perpetrators aborted their attempt and escaped in their small vessel at high speed. The crew was not injured and nothing was stolen.
